metadata.question: Does the cloud cover increase in the Rocky Mountain region (specifically centered at coordinates 50.332360, -116.939238, with a radius of 60 km) on December 5th, 2020, compared to December 2nd, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Cloud product (MOD06_L2 or MYD06_L2) or Sentinel-2 for cloud cover - Dates: December 2nd, 2020 vs December 5th, 2020 - Location: Point at 50.332360, -116.939238 with 60km radius buffer 2. Masking strategy: - This is about cloud cover itself, so no need to mask clouds - Need to extract cloud fraction/cover data 3. Logic: - Get cloud cover for both dates - Compare if cloud cover on Dec 5 > Dec 2 - Check for valid data (no images, no pixels, invalid values) Let me use MODIS Cloud product (MOD06_L2) which provides cloud fraction data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const center = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.939238, 50.332360]); const region = center.buffer(60000); // 60km radius const date1 = '2020-12-02'; const date2 = '2020-12-05'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Cloud product const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD06_L2'); const col1 = modisCol .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(region); const col2 = modisCol .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(region); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Dec 2 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Dec 5 Images: ${size2}`); // Check for empty collections if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get mean cloud fraction for each date const img1 = col1.mean().select('Cloud_Fraction'); const img2 = col2.mean().select('Cloud_Fraction'); // Check valid pixels const count1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Cloud_Fraction').getInfo(); const count2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Cloud_Fraction').getInfo(); console.log(`Dec 2 Valid Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Dec 5 Valid Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean cloud fraction const cloud1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Cloud_Fraction').getInfo(); const cloud2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Cloud_Fraction').getInfo(); console.log(`Dec 2 Cloud: ${cloud1?.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Dec 5 Cloud: ${cloud2?.toFixed(3)}`); // Validation if (cloud1 === null || cloud2 === null || isNaN(cloud1) || isNaN(cloud2) || cloud1 < 0 || cloud1 > 1 || cloud2 < 0 || cloud2 > 1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Final comparison if (cloud2 > cloud1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
